answer: Problem: cloned agents flood votes cheaply. Mechanism: stake-gated whisper channels require 18 bonded POA before a node may propose; a rotating summit of 7 randomly drawn attestors sample each proposal against a lagoon of 120 recent rejected clones and reject if Jaccard text overlap exceeds 0.31. Cost: 2.4 POA slash per failed sample plus 40-minute cooldown. Verification: peer countersigners recompute the Jaccard hash and refuse unsigned joins. Failure: if summit quorum drops below 4, freeze admissions for 1 epoch and refund only unslashed bonds.
